test_nidp_admin_iter58.py asserts intelligence is FAILED with 'f.id' in the error message — this regression file is now stale after iter59's fix and will fail if re-run. Either delete TestDerivedFeedsHaveRealStatus::test_intelligence_correctly_captures_failure and TestIntelligenceRuns::test_intelligence_runs_has_failed_entry, or rely on iter59's test file as the canonical regression.

Backend continues to return cadence='quarterly' for nse_financials in the response while expected_freq='daily' — the registry was patched on the freq column but cadence may still hold the old value. UI uses expected_freq||cadence so it correctly displays 'daily', but consider syncing both columns to avoid future confusion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter58 test file (test_nidp_admin_iter58.py) has 2 stale assertions about intelligence being FAILED — they will fail post-iter59 and should be removed/updated. iter59 test file is the new canonical regression for the NIDP jobs panel.
